name: toolcard-corner-clip-phone
description: A one-element tool group (session.module.css's .intentGroupRows) keeps the tool-row contracts in the real cascade on a phone. The Open control's 44px touch target overhangs its text line, so a tap one pixel inside its top or bottom edge must reach the control. The last rendered row's evidence band spans its row edge to edge, and a suppressed member's empty wrapper adds no space below it.

mutation.declaration: fixture-only, temporarily in harness.html, one at a time and restored after each run: .intentGroupRows { overflow: clip }, .intentGroupRows > div { overflow: clip }, .row { overflow: clip }, .body { margin-inline: 0 }, #group-band > div:last-child { margin-top: 8px }
mutation.note: Five mutations, one at a time, each restored before the next. Clipping the group and clipping a member wrapper each fail on the Open control's top edge, the only edge their box cuts. Clipping the row fails on both edges, which covers the bottom-edge assertion. Zeroing the evidence band's inline bleed fails with the band inset inside its row. Giving the suppressed member's empty wrapper a top margin fails with the group extending 8px below the band. The production stylesheets were not modified.
